# Runtime dependencies for the Streamlit dashboard only.
#
# Deliberately NOT `-e .`: installing the local package would pull in every
# dependency declared in pyproject.toml (xgboost, scikit-learn, shap, jupyter,
# matplotlib, seaborn), none of which the app runs. `app/dashboard.py` puts
# `src/` on sys.path instead, so `retention_optimizer` imports without an
# install.
#
# The app reads a single precomputed file, data/processed/dashboard_data.csv,
# regenerated by scripts/build_dashboard_data.py. Rebuilding it does need the
# modelling stack — use the full pyproject environment for that, not this list.
#
# Full development environment: `uv sync --extra dev` (see pyproject.toml).

streamlit==1.58.0
plotly==6.9.0
pandas==3.0.3
numpy==2.4.6
pulp==3.3.2
